name: @patdown/tsconfig
description: Shared TypeScript configuration presets for patdown

scripts.check: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.test: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs test && node --test typecheck-cache-safety.test.ts && tsc --showConfig -p fixtures/base/tsconfig.json >/dev/null && tsc --showConfig -p fixtures/node-library/tsconfig.json >/dev/null
scripts.typecheck: node ../../scripts/warn-direct-package-task.mjs typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile typecheck.tsbuildinfo && tsc -p fixtures/base/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p fixtures/node-library/tsconfig.json --noEmit
